tunnel.description: The tunnel network (the same as `bcl.edge` of the edge nodes) and the address of this pod in it.

address.description: The address of this pod in the tunnel network (the last usable address of `bcl.edge.cidr` by default on the nodes, `bcl.edge.upstream.address`).

prefixLength.description: The prefix length of the tunnel network (the one of `bcl.edge.cidr`).

listenPort.description: The UDP port of the edge nodes the pod dials (`bcl.edge.listenPort`).

address.description: The public address of the edge node, an IP or a DNS name (resolved once, when the pod starts), where the pod dials the tunnel.

tunnelAddress.description: The address of the edge node in the tunnel network (`bcl.edge.address`). By default the number at the end of the name of the node is the host number in the tunnel network (`edge1` gives 10.99.0.1).

publicKey.description: The WireGuard public key of the edge node (`wg show wg-edge public-key` on the node). A node without it is ignored.

nodes.description: The edge nodes, by name (the hostname of the node).

port.description: The public port, one of `bcl.edge.upstream.tcpPorts` of the edge nodes. The pod listens for the edge nodes on `tcpPortOffset` + `port`.

backend.description: The `host:port` of the server inside the cluster, which gets the PROXY header (v2) of the edge node with the address of the client.

tcp.description: The TCP services (not HTTP: the mail protocols) published by the edge nodes, by name.

tcpPortOffset.description: Added to a public port of `tcp` to get the port the pod listens on for the edge nodes (`bcl.edge.upstream.tcpPortOffset`).

loadBalancerIP.description: The address of the LoadBalancer Service that takes the connections of the LAN and of the cluster (the former address of the Gateway). Empty: the service takes any address.
